reason: The hypothesis combines the concept of a protective glaze layer from tribo-oxidation (P2, P8, P10, etc.) with a deliberately engineered composition gradient to enhance selective oxidation (new intervention), and links them through a mechanism where the gradient prevents abrupt elastic-plastic transitions (P8, P13). While the individual elements are well-known, the specific proposal to use a PVD-deposited Al-rich gradient to self-adaptively form a nanocrystalline glaze layer that governs wear by both oxidation protection and stress homogenization is not stated in any single passage or textbook, and integrates ideas from multiple sources into a new, testable hypothesis.
